notes.subject: Adonai wa rona
notes.rationale: אדנינו ke wa Molimo ka tlhaho mona, kahoo Adonai, eseng morena wa motho

notes.subject: מה אדיר
notes.rationale: puo ya makatsiso ya Seheberu — 'ho le bongata jwang!' — eseng potso ya nnete

notes.subject: תנה
notes.rationale: vocalisation e fetotseng ya נתן: 'o behile' kgahlanong le 'o tla beha' kapa JPS 'e bolelowa'

notes.subject: Yahwe
notes.rationale: papadi e bua le Yahwe ka kotloloho, e bitsa lebitso la hae

translation: Yahwe, Adonai wa rona, ho le bongata jwang lebitso la hao lefatsheng ho tloha ho hong le hong! O behile ⟨את⟩ bokgosi ba hao hodima mahodimo.

tokens.gloss: lefatsheng ho tloha ho hong le hong
